name: Fibonacci
summary: Print the first N Fibonacci numbers, one per line, using 64-bit wrapping arithmetic.

spec.description: The classic warm-up. Small N measures how fast a runtime starts; large N measures integer arithmetic, integer-to-text formatting and buffered output throughput.
spec.input: Exactly one argument N made only of ASCII digits (leading zeros allowed), with 0 ≤ N ≤ 1000000000.
spec.output: F(0), F(1), …, F(N-1) in decimal, one per line (each followed by \n), computed with unsigned 64-bit wrapping arithmetic (mod 2^64). Exit code 0.
rules: Iterative algorithm with two running values: no closed form, no recursion, no lookup tables.
Missing or extra arguments, non-digit characters or N > 1000000000: usage message on stderr, nothing on stdout, exit code 1.

benchmarks.name: Startup
benchmarks.description: N = 10: almost no work, so the time is dominated by process and runtime startup.

benchmarks.name: Throughput
benchmarks.description: N = 2,000,000 (40.8 MB of output): integer arithmetic, number formatting and buffered I/O.
